article_title: BBC drops Drag Race UK after eight series

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: Drag Race UK leaving the BBC after eight series and moving future programmes to Wow Presents Plus
The BBC launching a new international drag competition in Canada
RuPaul ending all versions of Drag Race around the world
The BBC buying the company that produces Drag Race UK
tasks.correct_answer: Drag Race UK leaving the BBC after eight series and moving future programmes to Wow Presents Plus
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה עוסקת בהחלטת ה־BBC להפסיק לשדר עונות עתידיות של התוכנית ובהעברתן לפלטפורמת Wow Presents Plus.

tasks.prompt: What reason did the BBC give for dropping the show?
options: The judges refused to appear in another series
Significant financial pressures required difficult choices
The programme had never been available on iPlayer
The production company stopped making entertainment shows
tasks.correct_answer: Significant financial pressures required difficult choices
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ה־BBC הסביר שהוא מתמודד עם לחצים כספיים משמעותיים ונדרש לקבל החלטות קשות במסגרת תוכנית החיסכון.

tasks.prompt: What does “groundbreaking” mean when the BBC describes Drag Race UK?
options: Filmed below ground
Very inexpensive to produce
Innovative and important in creating change
Cancelled before it reached an audience
tasks.correct_answer: Innovative and important in creating change
tasks.explanation_hebrew: groundbreaking פירושו חדשני ופורץ דרך; ה־BBC הדגיש את חשיבות התוכנית בהבאת הדראג הבריטי למיינסטרים.

tasks.prompt: What will happen to the current series that began in September 2026?
options: It will continue normally on BBC Three and iPlayer
It will be removed before the final episode
It will move immediately to BBC One
It will be replaced by Drag Race Canada
tasks.correct_answer: It will continue normally on BBC Three and iPlayer
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי הכתבה, העונה הנוכחית תמשיך כרגיל ב־BBC Three וב־iPlayer למרות השינוי לעונות העתידיות.

tasks.prompt: Why is the move to Wow Presents Plus described as a “new era”?
options: The programme will no longer have any judges
The show is changing from television entertainment to a sports event
Existing series will become unavailable everywhere
Future series will be distributed by the production company's own streaming platform
tasks.correct_answer: Future series will be distributed by the production company's own streaming platform
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי מציין שינוי באופן ההפצה: העונות העתידיות יעברו משידור BBC לפלטפורמת הסטרימינג של חברת ההפקה.

tasks.prompt: What does “a staple of LGBTQ+ culture” mean in the article?
options: A regular and important part of that culture
A programme watched only by celebrity judges
A temporary show with no cultural influence
A legal requirement for broadcasters
tasks.correct_answer: A regular and important part of that culture
tasks.explanation_hebrew: staple בהקשר זה פירושו חלק קבוע, מוכר וחשוב בתרבות הלהט״בית.

tasks.prompt: Describe where viewers will be able to watch the current, existing and future series of Drag Race UK.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להבחין בין העונה הנוכחית, העונות הקיימות והעונות העתידיות, ולציין את הפלטפורמות המתאימות.
expected_points: The current series launched in September 2026
